objective: Implement four small independent utilities in the firm-parallel-trial crate. Each module is self-contained: it does not use, and must not modify, any other module.

tasks.title: Implement src/slug.rs
tasks.brief: Implement slugify in src/slug.rs. Lowercase the input, keep ASCII alphanumerics, and replace every run of other characters with a single '-'. Remove leading and trailing separators. Change only src/slug.rs.

tasks.title: Implement src/roman.rs
tasks.brief: Implement to_roman in src/roman.rs. Return the roman numeral for 1..=3999 using standard subtractive notation (IV, IX, XL, XC, CD, CM). Return None outside that range. Change only src/roman.rs.

tasks.title: Implement src/wrap.rs
tasks.brief: Implement wrap in src/wrap.rs. Greedy word wrap on spaces: never split a word, drop the spaces at line breaks, and give a word longer than the width its own unbroken line. Whitespace-only or empty input yields no lines. Change only src/wrap.rs.

tasks.title: Implement src/columns.rs
tasks.brief: Implement align in src/columns.rs. Pad every column to its widest cell, join cells with a single space, and trim trailing whitespace from each line. Rows shorter than the widest row are padded with empty cells. Change only src/columns.rs.
